_note: One real capture of OpenCode 2.0.26 (openrouter/~deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-latest), S-4280: a session whose rules ask for everything ran the shell command `echo capture-hello`; GET /api/session/SID/permission was read while the permission was pending, then after an interrupt, and for a session the server doesn't have. A listing item has no `metadata` (the permission.asked event does); `save` and `source` are the listing's own.
